title.value: Glossary for public health surveillance in the age of data science
title.justification: The paper outlines a glossary specifically for public health surveillance focusing on the developments in data science.
title.quote: It is, therefore, the right time for a glossary of key terms in public health surveillance, with an emphasis on new data-science developments in the field.

analysis.description: The paper provides a glossary focused on key terms in public health surveillance, particularly emphasizing the influence of data science, big data, and new methodologies in enhancing surveillance and health monitoring.

type.justification: The paper is focused on creating a glossary and discussing theoretical concepts related to data science, public health surveillance, and methodologies rather than conducting experiments or empirical research.
type.quote: We do not aim to cover the whole field of surveillance but rather focus on how data science is changing methods and concepts.

name.justification: The paper is centered on public health surveillance and how data science is influencing this field.
name.quote: Public health surveillance is the ongoing systematic collection, analysis and interpretation of data... integrated with the timely dissemination...

name.justification: The paper highlights the role of data science in transforming public health surveillance methodologies.
name.quote: With the rapid development of data science, encompassing big data and artificial intelligence...

name.justification: Epidemiology is a key aspect in understanding public health surveillance as explained in the paper.
name.quote: In public health, aberration detection is the identification of anomalous events or patterns in data, with a clinical or public health potential relevance...

name.justification: The paper discusses the use of machine learning methods as tools in public health surveillance.
name.quote: Recent algorithmic advances have enabled profound gains in the performance of neural networks for machine learning.

is_contributed.justification: The paper does not contribute a new neural network model but discusses existing methods.
is_contributed.quote: Such machine learning methods also have the potential to advance aberration detection.

is_executed.justification: The paper is theoretical and does not involve executing models.
is_executed.quote: ...employing different connectionist (ie, data driven) or symbolic (ie, using logic and symbols) approaches.

is_compared.justification: There is no comparison of models in terms of performance within the paper.
is_compared.quote: In epidemiology and public health surveillance, machine learning is used as one tool to execute causal inference analysis...
